$comment: Compose Glimmer as a UI Builder palette. Component records and their canvas adapters are discovered from the real Glimmer call sites rendered by the catalog; this file owns catalog-level policy and disambiguates the nested Text and Icon calls that have no sticker of their own.

wasm.reason: The catalog-owned Wasm renderer links this repository's pinned CMP Glimmer port and invokes the real Glimmer composables.

native.reason: Generated Compose rendered against the released AndroidX Glimmer AAR through Robolectric, the same lane used by the catalog.

$comment_templates: The New design chooser's starting points, as branch-relative paths the design-artifacts pipeline copies from ui-builder/designs/ onto the delivery branch beside ui-builder.json. Each is a 960×720dp glasses frame (frame.seedDevice) built from real Glimmer components on the builder's column, so a new design opens on the additive display's black rather than the generic phone scaffold. There is deliberately no composeSourceExport: compose-ui-builder ships no Glimmer emitter, and a declaration naming one it does not ship would make the host refuse the catalog's exports rather than offer none.
$comment_components: `glimmer/icon` declares its properties because Glimmer's Icon(imageVector, contentDescription) has no parameter a design can carry as data, so the palette offered an icon nothing could configure. The three are the ones glimmer-ui-builder-renderer's `glimmer/icon` adapter already reads; the key stands in for the ImageVector exactly as m3-catalog's Icon does.

propertyCapabilities.name: iconKey
propertyCapabilities.notes: A Material icon key from the builder's icon catalog (`filled/info`, `rounded/callEnd`), drawn by the renderer runtime through googleMaterialIconImageVector. Glimmer's Icon takes an ImageVector, which no design can hold as data, so the key stands in for it exactly as m3-catalog's Icon does.

glimmer/sticker.excluded: The catalog's own preview frame is not a Glimmer library component.
